scope: Actual public Home Assistant ha-card renders on three Chromium platform targets, captured independently of the shared renderer.
referenceSourceNote: This reviewed source revision documents the styling contract. The installed release is identified separately by the public app and module bytes.
harness: Load only recorded public frontend modules and theme tokens, substitute the application bootstrap with an exposed loader, render fictional card content, then require matching consecutive compositor frames and a second independent run. Byte-identical baseline images share a path; each platform measurement and capture is retained in the manifest.
